ops.find: The government announced cuts of 350 teaching posts

event.label: reported
event.text: Italy: la Repubblica (Bologna) reports the government's school budget plan would cut about 350 teaching posts in Emilia-Romagna, and the FLC-CGIL union says a strike is "the only choice". The UIL union estimates 70 to 80 fewer posts in Bologna province; the FLC-CGIL also criticises bonuses for private schools.
